questions.chapter_title: Organic Compounds: Cycloalkanes and Their Stereochemistry
questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “cycloalkane”?

options.label: A
options.text: Stereoisomers in cyclic or restricted systems differing in whether substituents reside on the same face (cis) or opposite faces (trans).

options.label: B
options.text: A saturated cyclic hydrocarbon containing a ring of carbon atoms with the general formula CnH2n.

options.label: C
options.text: The total destabilizing energy in a cyclic molecule resulting from the sum of angle strain, torsional strain, and steric strain.

options.label: D
options.text: The destabilizing steric strain between an axial substituent and the axial hydrogens located two carbons away on the same face of cyclohexane.

questions.correct_answer: A saturated cyclic hydrocarbon containing a ring of carbon atoms with the general formula CnH2n.
questions.explanation: A accurate description of cycloalkane is: A saturated cyclic hydrocarbon containing a ring of carbon atoms with the general formula CnH2n.
